cases.name: source
cases.deck:
BSIM4 PARAMCHK regression
.model DUT NMOS LEVEL=54 NJS=0.05 NJD=1 PARAMCHK=1
M1 d g 0 b DUT L=1u W=2u AS=1p AD=1p
Vd d 0 0.5
Vg g 0 1
Vb b 0 0.02
.temp 27
.options gmin=1e-12
.op
.control
set numdgt=17
op
print @m1[gbs] @m1[gbd] i(Vb)
.endc
.end
warnings: Warning: Njs = 0.05 is less than 0.1. Setting Njs to 0.1.
